name: scl_style
title: Scene classification
abstract:
Scene classification layer derived from Sentinel-2 images using Sen2cor. Each image has been classified and the classes can be selected for viewing in this layer. The following classes are available:
Vegetation, non-vegetation, clouds (includes medium & high probability and cirrus), water, snow, cloud shadow and other (saturated or defective, dark area pixel and unclassified)

More information: Sen2Cor for Sentinel-2
